headline: NHL Status Report: Heiskanen to return for Stars against Golden Knights

parts.content: *Welcome to the NHL Status Report. Here is the latest lineup/injury news around the NHL.*

## **Dallas Stars**

<forge-entity title="Miro Heiskanen" slug="miro-heiskanen-8480036" code="player">Miro Heiskanen</forge-entity> will return for the Stars to play the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday (10 p.m. ET; HBO MAX, truTV, TNT), the first of consecutive road games at T-Mobile Arena. Their top defenseman missed five games with an upper-body injury and has not played since leaving early in the second period of a 6-5 win at the Washington Capitals on Nov. 3, when he was hit into the boards by <forge-entity title="Justin Sourdif" slug="justin-sourdif-8482088" code="player">Justin Sourdif</forge-entity>. Heiskanen has 11 points (three goals, eight assists) in 15 games and is averaging 24:53 of ice time. … Defenseman <forge-entity title="Lian Bichsel" slug="lian-bichsel-8483425" code="player">Lian Bichsel</forge-entity> (lower body) is out a couple of weeks, Stars coach Glen Gulutzan said. He was placed on injured reserve Saturday retroactive to Nov. 12.

## **Toronto Maple Leafs**

<forge-entity title="Morgan Rielly" slug="morgan-rielly-8476853" code="player">Morgan Rielly</forge-entity> could return from a lower-body injury for the Maple Leafs at the Chicago Blackhawks on Tuesday (7:30 p.m. ET; HBO MAX, TNT, TSN4). The defenseman, who hasn’t played since Nov. 7, was back at practice Monday in a noncontact jersey. Rielly has 12 assists in 18 games while averaging 18:46 of ice time. He was paired with <forge-entity title="Troy Stecher" slug="troy-stecher-8479442" code="player">Troy Stecher</forge-entity> at practice. "I thought he looked good, but there's other things besides me thinking he looks good that goes into the decision,” Toronto coach Jim Hiller said Monday. “So, we will figure that out this afternoon." … <forge-entity title="Kirill Marchenko" slug="kirill-marchenko-8480893" code="player">Kirill Marchenko</forge-entity> (lower body) skated Monday but remains week to week. The forward, who has not played since Oct. 26, has 14 points (six goals, eight assists) in 14 games.

## **Calgary Flames**

<forge-entity title="Jonathan Huberdeau" slug="jonathan-huberdeau-8476456" code="player">Jonathan Huberdeau</forge-entity> was assigned by the Flames to Calgary of the AHL on a conditioning loan Tuesday. The forward has yet to make his season debut after having resurfacing surgery in March. "He's continuing to check the boxes, so everything is looking good, and he's going in the right direction, Flames coach Ryan Huska said on Nov. 11. Huberdeau had 25 points (10 goals, 15 assists) in 50 games last season. The Flames visit the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday (10 p.m. ET; NBCSCA, SN).

## **Ottawa Senators**

<forge-entity title="Tyler Boucher" slug="tyler-boucher-8482674" code="player">Tyler Boucher</forge-entity> will make his NHL debut with the Senators, who visit the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday (7 p.m. ET; RDS, TSN3, TSN5). The forward, who was selected by Ottawa with the No. 10 pick in the 2021 NHL Draft, was recalled from Belleville of the American Hockey League on Monday after he had 10 points (five goals, five assists) in 17 games, including five points (two goals, three assists) in his past six. Boucher had 26 points (12 goals, 14 assists) in 47 games for Belleville last season. “It’s been a long journey,” Boucher said Monday. “I’m excited to get going.”

## **Florida Panthers**

<forge-entity title="Aleksander Barkov" slug="aleksander-barkov-8477493" code="player">Aleksander Barkov</forge-entity> and <forge-entity title="Brad Marchand" slug="brad-marchand-8473419" code="player">Brad Marchand</forge-entity> “are both close” to returning, Panthers coach Paul Maurice said before their game against the Edmonton Oilers on Tuesday (7 p.m. ET; SCRIPPS, SN, TVAS). The forwards have been out for more than a month with knee injuries. Barkov, who is Florida’s captain, injured his left knee Oct. 1, his second game of the season; he missed all of last season with a knee injury. Marchand was injured when he fell into the goal post on Oct. 6.

## **Minnesota Wild**

<forge-entity title="Filip Gustavsson" slug="filip-gustavsson-8479406" code="player">Filip Gustavsson</forge-entity> practiced with the Wild on Monday and could make his season debut next week. The goalie has yet to play after having offseason hip surgery but could have a quick stint with Iowa of the AHL if he’s cleared by doctors Tuesday. “Hopefully that occurs,” Minnesota coach John Hynes said. “And if it does, then there's a possibility he would play in Iowa for a game and then come back with us. Once we get the OK from the doctor, then we'll sit down and go through the plan." Gustavsson was 28-15-6 with a 2.69 goals-against average and .904 save percentage in 50 games (49 starts) last season. … <forge-entity title="Olli Maatta" slug="olli-maatta-8476874" code="player">Olli Maatta</forge-entity> (upper body) will be out one week; the defenseman took his last shift with 8:05 left in the third period of a 6-2 win at the Boston Bruins on Saturday, when he had one assist in 12:01 of ice time. Maatta has six points (one goal, five assists) and is plus-11 in 18 games while averaging 19:16 per game. Minnesota hosts the Nashville Predators on Tuesday (8 p.m. ET; Wild+, MINNHL, SCRIPPS, KSTC).

## **Los Angeles Kings**

<forge-entity title="Artemi Panarin" slug="artemi-panarin-8478550" code="player">Artemi Panarin</forge-entity> will miss his second straight game for the Kings at Boston on Tuesday (7 p.m. ET; ABTV, NESN). The forward is away from the team following the death of his grandfather, Vladimir. Panarin also missed a 3-2 loss to the Flames on Saturday. He leads Los Angeles with eight goals and 19 points in 17 games this season.

## **Edmonton Oilers**

<forge-entity title="Ryan Nugent-Hopkins" slug="ryan-nugent-hopkins-8476454" code="player">Ryan Nugent-Hopkins</forge-entity> (undisclosed) is questionable for the Oilers at Florida on Tuesday (7 p.m. ET; SCRIPPS, SN, TVAS). The forward was to be evaluated Monday after he missed a 5-2 win against the Philadelphia Flyers on Sunday. Nugent-Hopkins played 17:56 in a 1-0 victory at Toronto on Saturday. "You get to a certain age, we give you a day of rest," coach Mike Babcock said. "I don't actually know. Obviously, he's not feeling good, so we'll probably know more (Monday)." Nugent-Hopkins has 11 points (four goals, seven assists) in 12 games this season.

## **St. Louis Blues**

<forge-entity title="Philip Broberg" slug="philip-broberg-8481598" code="player">Philip Broberg</forge-entity> (lower body) and <forge-entity title="Jake Neighbours" slug="jake-neighbours-8482089" code="player">Jake Neighbours</forge-entity> (upper body) could play against the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday (8 p.m. ET; Prime Video, BN+, STLNHL, KTTV) after each practiced Monday. Broberg, a defenseman, did not practice Sunday after he left for what coach Jim Montgomery labeled “precautionary reasons” midway through the third period of a 4-1 loss to the Panthers on Saturday. Broberg has 13 points (four goals, nine assists) and is averaging 24:33 of ice time in 20 games. Neighbours, a forward, also did not practice Sunday after he played 16:19 against Florida. He has nine points (four goals, five assists) in 20 games. Each was considered day to day.

## **New York Islanders**

<forge-entity title="Jean-Gabriel Pageau" slug="jean-gabriel-pageau-8476419" code="player">Jean-Gabriel Pageau</forge-entity> (lower body) is a game-time decision for the Islanders against the Columbus Blue Jackets on Tuesday (7 p.m. ET; CBJHN, CBJNHL, MSGSN). The center, who has missed their past two games, practiced Monday, and coach Peter DeBoer said he has his "fingers crossed" Pageau could play. He has eight points (one goal, seven assists) in 17 games. … <forge-entity title="Logan Stanley" slug="logan-stanley-8479378" code="player">Logan Stanley</forge-entity> (undisclosed) is not expected to play; the defenseman did not practice Monday and is day to day. Stanley was injured during the second period of a 6-2 win at Anaheim on Saturday. He has five assists in 19 games and is averaging 20:43 of ice time. ... <forge-entity title="Calum Ritchie" slug="calum-ritchie-8484221" code="player">Calum Ritchie</forge-entity> (lower body) wore a noncontact jersey at practice Monday. The forward has not played since Oct. 17. He has two points (one goal, one assist) in eight games.

## **Chicago Blackhawks**

<forge-entity title="Tyler Bertuzzi" slug="tyler-bertuzzi-8477479" code="player">Tyler Bertuzzi</forge-entity> (upper body) is expected to play for the Blackhawks against the Maple Leafs on Tuesday (7:30 p.m. ET; HBO MAX, TNT, TSN4). The forward did not practice Monday after he left early in the third period of a 5-4 shootout loss to the Jets on Saturday. … <forge-entity title="Bowen Byram" slug="bowen-byram-8481524" code="player">Bowen Byram</forge-entity> (upper body) practiced Monday and skated Tuesday but is expected to miss the next two games. Chicago concludes a five-game homsetand against the Columbus Blue Jackets on Thursday. The defenseman has not played since Oct. 13. Asked if Byram could go on the Blackhawks' three-game road trip, which begins at Calgary on Saturday, coach Jeff Blashill said, "I don't know that answer yet. I think we'll reevaluate after these two home games."

## **San Jose Sharks**

<forge-entity title="Kiefer Sherwood" slug="kiefer-sherwood-8480748" code="player">Kiefer Sherwood</forge-entity> (upper body) is week to week, Sharks coach Ryan Warsofsky said before their game against the Flames on Tuesday (10 p.m. ET; NBCSCA, SN). The forward was injured in the third period of a 4-2 win against the Predators on Sunday. Sherwood has eight points (two goals, six assists) in 23 games. Forward <forge-entity title="Brett Leason" slug="brett-leason-8481517" code="player">Brett Leason</forge-entity> was recalled from San Jose of the AHL.

## **New York Rangers**

<forge-entity title="Pavel Dorofeyev" slug="pavel-dorofeyev-8481604" code="player">Pavel Dorofeyev</forge-entity> missed the Rangers’ 3-1 win against the Canadiens on Monday because of a lower-body injury. The forward left practice early Sunday for an undisclosed reason but skated in the morning Monday before being scratched before puck drop. New York does not play again until Nov. 22, when it hosts the Carolina Hurricanes.
